I have updated and completed (for now) my nation's history, agreed upon with [nation]Nordiheim[/nation]. Here it is: 

"[i]Before 1908 - Rural Nordiheimians, likely never having seen a city before, have lived in the region that would become Coober Pedi for generations before the arrival of the miners from the Ngarabana Clan. Aside from a few sightings, these Nordiheimians had been isolated from other Nordiheimians, having developed their own Aboriginal culture different from the Asatru culture of the other Nordiheimians. These original residents of the land have been integrated into the Coober Pedi populace, now at 7,000,000, for quite some time now, so all we have left of them are primitive stone tools preserved via archaeology.

1908 - Ngarabana Aboriginal miners (descended from intermarriage between the Ngarabana and the Norse) from the Sorland region of the United Regions of Nordiheim are sent northeast to mine opal from where the natives called (and still call) "Mala Wiru Ngurrarpa," or "Land of the Water Stones" in Aboriginal, their language. The purpose of this mining was to gather enough material to help Asatrus build a "grand statue" of the World Tree Yggdrasil as a "proof show" of their religion in Midgard, the capital city of Nordiheim. Despite some initial issues with the native tribe currently living there, the miners were successful and built the future underground capital of the Borderlands of Coober Pedi: Coober Pedi City. Until 1915.

1915 - Religious conflict, likely caused by tension created by the public display of the Asatru priests of Midgard, made their way to the colony Coober Pedi City was in from the west, and civilians were murdered left and right with no good reason. This flared tensions, and although the council of Nordiheim were able to get its act together and make the necessary reforms to satisfy and quell the outrage and grievances of their populace over the next four years, the people of Coober Pedi City had lost their trust and faith in the council, from their inability to prevent the religious violence and murders in their part of the nation, and chose to separated themself from Nordiheim after a rather unanimous vote. They created the nation now known as "the Borderlands of Coober Pedi," making Coober Pedi City the capital, and created their own culture, a hybrid of Nordiheim values, Aboriginal spirituality, and the rugged lifestyle of the "Outback" of the region that the miners had perfected. The devastating religious conflict situation that caused the country's founding would finally end four years later in 1919.

1915-1916 - The temporary leaders of Coober Pedi transition into a liberal democracy, which was and is beloved by their people. This was a clear rejection of the values of the rebel nobles of Nordiheim who, in search of revenge, would cause the Nobles' War, which lasted from 1944 (or 1945, depending on your interpretation) to 1950. Coober Pedi wouldn't get involved in this, though, and relations between Coober Pedi and Nordiheim would improve over the next century and a few.

2023 - New Prime Minister, Edward Joseph, takes up the mantle of Coober Pedi. A day after he became leader, he became embroiled in a war with the neighboring country to the north, Brasilistan, which had been using foreign workers and locking them underground, forcing them to mine diamonds. This was internationally condemned by the United Nations World Assembly, but they didn't stop, and reports came to Coober Pedi City that some of the miners were Coober Pedians. This led to war, which is currently ongoing. Edward decided to go with a bombing strategy versus a more costly, conscript-dependent strategy, which, along with a lot of other policies of his, has increased patriotism, but this strategy decision has led to mixed international reactions, as the carpet bombings have led to great loss of life in Brasilistan. The next day, he sent in elite teams of soldiers to infiltrate Brasilistan's capital city, instead of using tons of conscripts or going nuclear - like many of the things he does, Edward decided to play this safe. But as a nationalistic party backs him in his goals, he has to choose between giving into the fanfare, or continuing his service to the citizens, not to himself.

2024 - The Nationalistic Party of Coober Pedi continues to grow, as the war with Brasilistan continues on. Brasilistan has lost the majority of their soldiers due to the bombings and the infiltration over 12 moons. But they continue to fight, and the capital city of Brasilistan hasn't been captured yet due to all remaining loyal Brasilistan soldiers huddling up there. Seeing the last bastion of Brasilistan in his sight, its capital, Edward Joseph, beloved by his people, decided to send in the rest of the armed forces to finish them off.

Earlier this Year (2025) - After a year-long siege of the Capital, Brasilistan fell to Coober Pedi, becoming a new state and giving millions of new citizens to Coober Pedi overnight. Edward Joseph began to be called "Coloniser-in-Chief" by his populace, as they praised him for leading them to victory without using nukes. Brasilistan's past citizens also thanked him, thankful for minimal civilian casualties and for him toppling their despotic, medium-sized government. They were all given full citizenship as reciprocation, and they got to enjoy the vast liberties of the Borderlands of Coober Pedi in their new lives, as some Coober Pedians from the Mainland relocated north to the new colony of the past lands of Brasilistan, and vice versa. Luckily, this story got a happy ending."[/i]
